headline: Will the War Resume Before the Midterms? Latest Odds
status: A Houthi strike damaged the Khurais pumping station on Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline on Oct. 4; flow stopped briefly and is reported back to normal. Pezeshkian called talks with the US "meaningless" and Ghalibaf says the strait stays shut until Iran's seven conditions are met. Brent eased to about $100.
change_note: Since Oct. 4: oil-infrastructure war +3 (Khurais hit), limbo −1, half-open −1, deal −1. War by Nov. 3 now 58%.

bets.cond: The IRGC claims a hit, lays mines or strikes infrastructure
Iran accepts US sequencing, or round two is set with text
The East-West line or Yanbu is knocked offline for days, not hours
